user.title: Cookbook
user.description: Choose where recipes are stored. Local recipes survive integration updates.

nextcloud.title: Nextcloud
nextcloud.description: Enter an app password. Leave blank to keep the saved password.

transfer.title: Copy recipes?
transfer.description: Copy all Nextcloud recipes and images once? Nextcloud remains unchanged. Existing local recipes are preserved and previously copied recipes are skipped. Without copying, the existing local collection opens (empty on first use). There is no automatic synchronization. A failed transfer keeps the previous mode active.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Check the URL and certificate.
error.transfer_failed: Transfer failed. Mode was not changed. Check connectivity and recipe images, then retry.
